title: Understanding Your Queensland Teacher Salary: From Hourly to Annual Pay
description: Convert a Queensland teacher salary from hourly to annual with our guide. Includes 38-hour week, fortnightly pay, tax, super, and casual loading explained.
salarySummary: For a Queensland teacher earning an hourly rate, the annual salary is estimated by multiplying the rate by 38 hours per week and 52 weeks, assuming a standard full-time week.

faqs.q: How does casual loading affect a Queensland teacher salary?
faqs.a: Casual loading is an extra 25% paid on top of the base hourly rate to compensate for lack of leave entitlements. For example, if the base rate is $40 per hour, casual loading brings it to $50 per hour. The calculator on the timesheet page has a checkbox to add this loading automatically.

faqs.q: Is superannuation included in the hourly rate for a Queensland teacher?
faqs.a: No, superannuation is paid on top of your ordinary earnings. The super guarantee is 12% of your ordinary time earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. So if your annual gross is $80,000, your employer pays an extra $9,600 into your super fund.

faqs.q: What tax applies to a Queensland teacher salary in 2026–27?
faqs.a: For 2026–27, resident tax rates are: nil up to $18,200, 15% from $18,201 to $45,000, 30% from $45,001 to $135,000, 37% from $135,001 to $190,000, and 45% above $190,000. The Medicare levy is generally 2%. Our calculator uses these rates with the full tax-free threshold.

bodyMarkdown:
## Converting a Queensland Teacher Salary: Hourly to Annual

When evaluating a **Queensland teacher salary**, understanding how your hourly rate translates into annual, fortnightly, and after-tax figures is essential. Whether you are a permanent employee or a casual teacher, the conversion follows a straightforward formula: multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52 weeks. For a standard full-time role, we assume 38 hours per week, as set by the Fair Work Commission for the National Employment Standards.

### The Basic Formula

Annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52.

For example, if your hourly rate is $45.00 and you work 38 hours each week:

$45.00 × 38 × 52 = $88,920 per year.

This figure is your gross annual salary before tax, super, and any deductions. It assumes the same rate every week, with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances. If you are a casual teacher, your rate may already include a 25% casual loading – but on the [timesheet](/), you enter your base hourly rate and tick the casual loading checkbox to add the 25% on top. Never enter a rate that already includes the loading.

### Fortnightly Pay

Many teachers are paid fortnightly. To find your gross fortnightly pay, multiply your weekly pay by 2. Using the example above:

Weekly pay = $45.00 × 38 = $1,710.00
Fortnightly pay = $1,710.00 × 2 = $3,420.00

This helps when budgeting or comparing salary offers.

### The National Minimum Wage and Award Rates

From 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. Casual employees receive an additional 25% loading, making the casual minimum $33.05 per hour. However, most teachers are covered by specific awards or enterprise agreements that set higher rates. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides [pay guides](/blog) for different industries. A **Queensland teacher salary** is typically above the minimum, but the conversion method remains the same.

### Superannuation Paid on Top

Super guarantee contributions are 12% of your ordinary time earnings, paid by your employer on top of your salary. This means your total employment cost is higher than your gross pay. For the $88,920 example, the employer would contribute an extra $10,670.40 into your super fund (up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830). Super is not deducted from your hourly rate – it is additional. For more details, see our guide on [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging).

### Tax and Take-Home Pay

Your take-home pay depends on the 2026–27 resident tax rates and the Medicare levy. The tax-free threshold is $18,200. Income up to $45,000 is taxed at 15%, then 30% up to $135,000, 37% up to $190,000, and 45% above that. The Medicare levy is generally 2% of your taxable income. Using the $88,920 annual gross, the estimated tax (including Medicare) would be approximately $18,167, leaving a take-home of about $70,753 per year, or $1,361 per week. Our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) page provides more detail.

### Queensland Average Weekly Earnings

According to the Australian Bureau of Statistics, full-time adult ordinary time earnings in Queensland were $2,039.70 per week in May 2026. This is an average across all occupations and industries, not a median for any specific job like a teacher. It can serve as a benchmark, but your individual **Queensland teacher salary** will depend on your classification, experience, and school sector.

### Casual Loading and Its Impact

If you are a casual teacher, your hourly rate typically includes a 25% loading to compensate for not receiving paid leave. On the [timesheet](/), you enter your base rate (without loading) and check the casual loading box. The calculator then adds 25% to your base rate before computing annual figures. For instance, a base rate of $40.00 becomes $50.00 with loading. This higher rate is used for the annual conversion, but remember that casual teachers do not accrue annual or sick leave.

### Using the Reference Tables

Our [reference tables](/data) include the National Minimum Wage, award rates, and tax brackets. They are updated with the latest Fair Work Commission and Australian Taxation Office figures. You can also explore [average pay](/topics/average-pay) for different states and industries.

### Important Note

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

For more on converting hourly rates, see [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion). If you are comparing job offers, our [job pay](/topics/job-pay) section can help.
